name: Devilium
source:
Devilium - atmospheric, psychological horror in the format of an interactive book. You must solve the moral conundrum by reading a visual novel and choosing your own path by selecting impactful dialogues. You will learn what past actions and mistakes can cost to other people. And it all depends on you, whether the protagonist will have the best outcome of this terrible adventure.

"I am Devilium, I am the embodiment of your deepest fears hidden in an interactive shell. I will open all the pustules of your personality, forcing you to open the dark side of your soul. I will plunge you into the depressing depths of your darkest memories, overstepping all bounds. I know no pity, I know no mercy, I am the epitome of indifference. Give me your hand and you'll never be the same again… Are you ready to open up?"

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20201031061439/https://store.steampowered.com/app/1439230/]Steam[/url]]
